summary:
MED-TWIN

MED TWIN aims to contribute to the advancement of astronaut healthcare by integrating physical health monitoring with mental wellness support.For astronauts, it provides a convenient way to monitor important health indicators, track sleep quality, manage nutritional intake and receive personalised relaxation support. This may help identify potential health concerns early and support their physical and psychological well-being during space missions. Furthermore, the technologies developed for MED TWIN could inspire future healthcare applications on Earth, particularly in remote patient monitoring, sleep management and personalised wellness. The platform enhances mission safety by combining personalized baseline calibration, AI pattern analysis, historical trend tracking, daily wellness check-ins. This is crucial for deep-space missions, as it provides instant visual triage, bridges raw wearable data with clinical decision-support, reduces false alarms, and empowers crew autonomy when real-time communication with Earth is delayed. MED-TWIN is also critical for deep-space missions because it provides crew autonomy during communication delays with Earth, translates complex biometrics into instant 3D visual triage, tracks individual baselines to catch subtle health drifts early, and uses proactive simulations to prevent medical emergencies before they happen.
details:
This very software monitors and analyses HRV, heart rate , breathing rate alongside a short mood check in and many more. Since astronauts experience isolation, confinement, disrupted sleep cycles, demanding workloads and separation from family, your invention should have an intelligent mental wellness system that detects stress, understands the astronaut's needs and provides personalized support.

Monitor the astronaut's body and identify unusual changes before they become serious health concerns and helps the astronaut's physical health in the long run as well as mental health which help astronauts manage stress, anxiety, loneliness and sleep difficulties through relaxation features.

One of the biggest factors we consider is stress, anxiety, loneliness and isolation were considered. This inspired a our software, which provides personalized relaxation activities and emotional support.
